title: Audit, Governance & Data Retention
completion_rule: NODE-65 is complete only after every P0 gap is closed with executed production-like evidence.

gaps.title: Production Governance service factory composition
gaps.evidence_required: Deployed API composes PostgresGovernanceServiceFactory with real session factory and proves authenticated org-scoped audit search plus atomic governance mutation+audit commit.

gaps.title: Mandatory high-risk audit ingress is not wired across all producers
gaps.evidence_required: Executed matrix proving canonical Audit events for auth/session/token, membership/role, project/archive/delete, sensitive asset download/delete, brand publication, artifact approval/restore, constraint override, external write tools, billing/credits, platform admin/provider/registry/DLQ and agent writes.

gaps.title: Deletion worker and irreversible adapters are not production-composed
gaps.evidence_required: Durable idempotent worker proves identify -> hold check -> deactivate -> erase -> object GC -> search/vector GC -> completion, including crash/retry recovery and Legal Hold races.

gaps.title: Audit export worker/download lifecycle is not production-composed
gaps.evidence_required: Durable JSON/CSV export job, bounded query, encrypted object result, short-lived signed download, authorization recheck and audit of export/download.

gaps.title: Retention sweeper and physical GC enforcement are not wired
gaps.evidence_required: Production-like sweeper proves active policy version selection, candidate calculation, Legal Hold exclusion, object/search/vector deletion and completion evidence without mutating append-only audit facts.

gaps.title: Platform security unified audit query is incomplete
gaps.evidence_required: SECURITY_ADMIN can query safe platform-admin audit plus organization canonical audit with explicit source identity and without leaking raw metadata/secrets; ordinary org admins remain tenant-scoped.

gaps.title: Data-subject scope discovery/anonymization is incomplete
gaps.evidence_required: Real user/org deletion scope enumerates relational records, object storage, search/vector indexes, analytics identifiers and legally retained references; completion report proves each eligible surface removed/anonymized.

gaps.title: Hosted CI and production-like E2E not yet executed green
gaps.evidence_required: GitHub-hosted workflow executes compile, Ruff, Pyright, pytest, full Alembic chain, append-only mutation rejection, legacy normalization, hash-chain writes and API contract regression successfully.

gaps.title: Jurisdiction-specific retention/legal requirements need professional review
gaps.evidence_required: Launch-country legal/privacy review approves or replaces technical baseline retention policy versions.

gaps.title: Canonical organization Audit facts are append-only
gaps.evidence: 0025 migration adds immutable UPDATE/DELETE trigger; application exposes append/search but no ordinary audit mutation route.

gaps.title: Audit payload redaction contract exists
gaps.evidence: Recursive key redaction, prompt/content hashing, URL query stripping and secret-shaped free-text scrubbing are implemented before persistence.

gaps.title: Legal Hold blocks deletion core path
gaps.evidence: Service checks recorded and live holds; repository rechecks active holds before ERASING and serializes hold/erase transitions per organization.

gaps.title: Organization audit read is separated from governance management/export
gaps.evidence: ADMIN retains admin.audit.read only; OWNER additionally receives governance.manage and audit.export.

gaps.title: Agent actor attribution is explicit
gaps.evidence: AGENT AuditActor requires run ref, version and human initiator and rejects actor_id=system.
